decisions.reason: The gallery photo count does not change the required hover-animation behavior or its mobile applicability.
Providing around 50 gallery photos does not change the configured category tabs or optional other-photography area.
The content quantity does not alter the requirement that viewers be able to browse and scroll through the interactive gallery.
The number of supplied photos has no effect on homepage button destinations or navigation behavior.
The gallery photo count does not change package counts, pricing presentation, square-footage ranges, or prices.
The source establishes a gallery photo quantity but does not select or change homepage hero imagery, overlay color, opacity, or emphasis.
Although nearby context mentions providing photos for services, the source does not allocate the approximately 50 photos to services or change the requirement for representative imagery per service.
The gallery content quantity does not modify the existing site-wide visual and image-focused presentation style.
The gallery photo count has no effect on the mobile pricing table's horizontal-scrolling behavior.
The source does not change the display, selection, or transparency requirements for individual-service pricing.
The gallery photo quantity does not affect the one-time pricing model or visibility of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
